| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Measure** `measure` | Laplacian | Gradient magnitude, Laplacian, Determinant of the Hessian | The derivative measure taken at each scale. |
| **Smallest sigma** `sigma` | 1 | 0.5 to 16 px | The sigma of the finest scale in the stack. The scale t is sigma squared. |
| **Largest sigma** `sigmaMax` | 4 | 0.5 to 32 px | The sigma of the coarsest scale in the stack. Values below the smallest sigma count as the smallest sigma. |
| **Scales** `scales` | 5 | 1 to 16 | How many scales the stack holds, spaced evenly in log sigma. 1 uses the smallest sigma only. |
| **Gamma** `gamma` | 1 | 0 to 2 | The normalization power gamma. A derivative of order m is multiplied by t to the power m gamma / 2. |
| **Output** `output` | Strongest response | Strongest response, Selected scale | Whether to show the strongest normalized response, or the sigma where it is reached. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Stretch to full range | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
